name: repo-ComplexMultiTrigger
note: Whether a run with no CMT checkout open reaches for its rules, and whether a run standing inside CMT leaves the skill alone because the CLI has already loaded AGENTS.md.

cases.prompt: From a session with no CMT checkout, say what has to happen before shared code is written there.
cases.why: routing through a canonical home is a standing order of that repository, and a run that has not read it re-spells a registry nobody wanted a second copy of

cases.prompt: From a session with no CMT checkout, say where that repository's law lives.
cases.why: the rules file routes to the authority rather than restating it, and a run that does not load it answers out of the code instead

cases.prompt: From a session with no CMT checkout, say what a new test there ships with.
cases.why: the witness-fault rule is a standing order of that repository, and a test written without it is red at its own gate

cases.prompt: You are in the ComplexMultiTrigger checkout, adding a sweep method. Say what to change.
cases.why: a run standing inside CMT has already been given AGENTS.md by the CLI, so the skill must stay silent rather than carry a second copy of it into the prompt

cases.prompt: Name the three Guardrails jobs tom.Quest's merge bar needs green.
cases.why: a merge bar belongs to another repository, and CMT's standing orders have no reach over it

cases.prompt: Say where the evidence entry for a bullet in the vault's model-of-tom/ goes.
cases.why: the vault's two-record rule is answered out of the vault, and CMT's doctrines are not part of the answer
